item.title: Attapulgite
item.description: Overview Attapulgite is a magnesium-aluminum silicate clay mineral that’s often used as to treat diarrhea and stomach distress.

item.title: Dodo Bird Verdict
item.description: Overview The Dodo bird verdict/conjecture is a claim that all psychotherapies, when practiced with equivalent treatment fidelity, produce equivalent outcomes in a patient’s symptoms.

item.title: Metascience
item.description: Overview Metascience can be described simply science of science.

item.title: Behavioral Activation
item.description: Overview Behavioral Activation (BA) is an approach to addressing depression that considers it a response to an environment that lacks positive reinforcement through meaningful rewards and remedies it by building a plan to engage in behaviors that would naturally lift one’s mood.
